assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original garment illustration for a mobile wardrobe app, inspired by the hand-drawn one-ink cafe packaging in the two provided STYLE REFERENCE images. Subject: a short-sleeve crew-neck T-SHIRT, front view, slightly tilted with a relaxed asymmetric silhouette, tiny two-dot eyes and a simple curved smile integrated into the middle of the shirt. No human, mannequin, limbs, hanger or other objects. Draw as friendly retro screen-printed line art: bold rounded imperfect contours, minimal folds, plenty of negative space, confident 8-12 px strokes at 1024 px, small solid ink areas only at collar and hem. Use exactly one flat deep forest-green ink (#315F4C). IMPORTANT: genuine transparent background; all interior negative spaces of the shirt remain transparent too, no cream fill, no white silhouette, no paper backdrop, no texture behind the art, no drop shadow. The design must work as a single-color alpha stencil which can be tinted by code. Square canvas, entire garment contained centered within middle 78% of canvas, generous 11% empty margin all sides. Balanced graphic style, not a generic thin-line stock icon, not kawaii/anime, no gradients, no realism, no lettering, no words or logos. Reference images supply only stroke character and restrained facial features; do not reproduce coffee cups, cookies, brand text, packaging or compositions.
assets.reference: Dos referencias de Café Sinónimo adjuntas por el usuario.
